definitions: An occupational or topographic surname originating as an occupation for someone who worked or lived in a forest.
An unincorporated community in Le Flore County, Oklahoma, United States.

blocks.text: Forrester is an unincorporated community in Le Flore County, Oklahoma, United States. A post office was established at Forrester on June 8, 1915; it closed on February 14, 1922.

Forrester Research, Inc. is a research and advisory firm working in research, consulting and events. Forrester’s clients include large global business, technology and consumer enterprises. The firm is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
Forrester is a surname of Anglo/Norman origin, referring to a forester. Notable people with the surname include:
